# Supported practice after the holidays

A returning volunteer asked for supported practice on the changed booking screen. The request should not imply loss of competence. Software changes and people need time away. [[Volunteer handbook]] can make re-entry ordinary, rather than reserve help for newcomers. Record the changed screen, not a judgment about the person who requested assistance.
